findings.evidence: The definition forms bosonic and fermionic sector annihilation maps using C_h tensor I and says the bounded extension comes from lem-nrqm-composites-bounded-tensor-maps. That supplier assumes the input operator is bounded; the definition does not establish or directly supply the needed Cauchy–Schwarz bound |C_h(v)| ≤ ||h|| ||v||, and has no justified_by result. The later lem-qft-fock-ccr-car derives this bound at step 1.2 but already depends on this definition's sector maps, so it does not license the construction. Establish the bound before extending, and identify the scalar tensor factor C ⊗̂ H^{⊗(n−1)} with H^{⊗(n−1)}, or cite exact suppliers for these steps.

The title promises a joint spectrum, while the body constructs a joint projection-valued measure and coordinate multipliers but never defines or characterizes the joint-spectrum set. Dereziński, Mathematical Introduction to Quantum Field Theory, §1.5, printed p. 7 (https://www.fuw.edu.pl/~derezins/qft-lectures.pdf), defines joint spectrum for strongly commuting self-adjoint operators by nonzero joint spectral projections for every coordinate-neighborhood box. The item does not state that criterion or give a spectrum formula. Retitle to the joint spectral measure actually constructed, or add the definition and prove the spectrum claim.
